final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanspatial s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM grouped), paired AS (SELECT g.fundflux, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.total, 0) as ratio FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM paired) SELECT p.fundflux, p.cnt, p.ratio, p.cnt - a.avg_cnt as cnt_minus_avg FROM paired p CROSS JOIN averages a WHERE a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > a.avg_cnt ORDER BY p.fundflux
